entry.title: Food and hospitality services
entry.use_when: The work behind a smoother meal or better welcome.
entry.scope: A perspective to combine with selected help roles
entry.freshness: Verify current local practices and consequential facts for each use.
entry.limitations: A support perspective, not a credential, actual job assignment or grant of access.

variants.label: Find the queue
variants.method: Time ordering, payment, preparation and pickup separately. Compare demand bursts with each station’s throughput and test the smallest bottleneck change.
variants.output: A station-by-station observation sheet and one lunch-period trial.

variants.label: Plan replenishment
variants.method: Compare portions prepared, sold and left by service period; separate stockouts from low demand before changing batch size.
variants.output: A simple replenishment experiment and a waste/stockout measure.

pattern.activation: meal service, stocking, a busy shift or a customer message needs practical coordination.
